title: MARS: Multiscale Appearance-Residual Streams for Video Forgery Detection
abstract: arXiv:2611.12508v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Generalizing deepfake detection across facial manipulation and fully generated video remains challenging due to forgery traces varying with the manipulation method and scene content. Explicit spatial and temporal feature differences offer a way to capture this variation, but also respond to natural texture and motion, motivating their joint interpretation with appearance features. We investigate whether combining multiscale feature differences with adapted appearance representations improves detection across both forgery categories. We introduce Multiscale Appearance-Residual Streams (MARS), a two-path video detector. The residual path applies fixed spatial and temporal difference-of-Gaussians operators to frozen intermediate features and models the resulting differences alongside appearance context across frames. The semantic path adapts the encoder's normalization parameters for frame classification, and a clip-dependent gate

translated_title: MARS：用于视频伪造检测的多尺度外观-残差流
translated_abstract: 由于伪造痕迹会随篡改方法和场景内容而变化，使深度伪造检测在面部篡改与完全生成视频两类之间保持泛化能力仍然具有挑战性。显式的空间与时间特征差异提供了一种捕捉这种变化的途径，但它们同样会对自然纹理和运动产生响应，因此需要将其与外观特征进行联合解释。我们研究了将多尺度特征差异与自适应外观表示相结合是否能提升对这两类伪造的检测效果。我们提出了多尺度外观-残差流，这是一种双路径视频检测器。残差路径对冻结的中间特征应用固定的空间与时间高斯差分算子，并结合跨帧的外观上下文对所得差异进行建模。语义路径通过自适应调整编码器的归一化参数来进行帧分类，并由一个依赖于片段的门控机制……
tldr: MARS提出了一种双路径视频伪造检测器，通过对冻结特征施加多尺度空间-时间高斯差分算子提取残差差异，并与自适应外观表示及跨片段门控机制相结合，从而在面部篡改和全生成视频两类深度伪造检测上实现更强的泛化能力。
en_tdlr: MARS is a two-path video forgery detector that extracts multiscale spatial-temporal difference-of-Gaussians residuals from frozen features and fuses them with adapted appearance representations via a clip-dependent gating mechanism, improving generalization across both facial manipulation and fully generated deepfake videos.
